svg.title: One core, two ways to adopt it
svg.desc: The configurable architecture and opinionated Grok Bot preset share a core. Runtime-specific deployment remains explicit. Capability-aware transpilation is a future direction, not an implemented compiler.
svg.text: One core, two ways to adopt it
Keep the reusable architecture separate from one owner’s preferred operating flow.
Evidence, state, handoffs and authority boundaries
Feedback loops with measured, reversible change
Select roles, review gates, cadences and tools
Keep the core truthfulness and authority constraints
Do not inherit the preset’s ceremony by accident
Use the opinionated Grok Bot preset
Start with a prescriptive flow and persona catalog
Include routines, retros and learning practices
Bind the manual blueprint to actual runtime features
Discover the user’s tools → map supported features → flag gaps → validate behavior before adoption.
